text_helper: Table 6. Comparator output connected internally to break inputs — section 6.3 Using an external emergency signal together with the internal comparator. Description, Register, Bit, Configuration(1).

rows: 0 (not inverted), comparators input connected as shown in previous sections
AF is not enabled on BKIN1/2 related pins

0001: TIM1 BRK or TIM1 BRK_ACTH(2) 0010: TIM1 BRK2 0011: TIM8 BRK or TIM8 BRK_ACTH(3) 0100: TIM8 BRK2 0101: TIM1 BRK2 + TIM8 BRK2 1100: TIM20 BRK or TIM20 BRK_ACTH(4) 1101: TIM20 BRK2 1110: TIM1 BRK2 + TIM8 BRK2 + TIM20 BRK2
notes: 1. Some newer STM32 series, such as STM32U5 abandoned the use of BRK_ACTH identifier using name system level or internal fault instead. The functionality remains analogous.
2. TIM1 BRK in case of COMP4 and COMP7, or TIM1 BRK_ACTH in case of COMPx, x = 1, 2, 3, 5, and 6.
3. TIM8 BRK in case of COMP4 and COMP7, or TIM8 BRK_ACTH in case of COMPx, x = 1, 2, 3, 5, and 6.

4. TIM20 BRK in case of COMP4 and COMP7, or TIM20 BRK_ACTH in case of COMPx, x= 1, 2, 3, 5, and 6. On the contrary, the user may prefer to make use of the external error signal in conjunction with the internal one:
